property_summary: The paused() function must return the same boolean value before and immediately after calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue with an empty array.
Calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue with an empty array does not change the return value of paused()
paused() must return the same boolean value before and after calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue with en empty array.
paused() returns the same boolean value before and after any call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue
Pausing the contract and then observing that paused() returns true, regardless of any previous calls to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue.
After adding a node delegator contract, the LRT configuration remains unchanged.
After adding a node delegator contract, the lrtConfig address stored in the contract is not the zero address.
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the lrtConfig address in the contract should not be the zero address when a successful initialization has occurred.
After any series of calls that includes addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the lrtConfig address remains the same as initially set by the constructor.
The lrtConfig address must never change after initialization.
After adding any number of node delegators, maxNodeDelegatorCount must be at least the number of queued node delegators.
Calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue does not change maxNodeDelegatorCount
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue with empty array, maxNodeDelegatorCount does not decrease.
After any call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the value of maxNodeDelegatorCount must equal its value before the call.
After updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount is called with some value X, calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue with at most X contracts must not revert with MaximumNodeDelegatorCountReached.
After any number of calls to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, maxNodeDelegatorCount never decreases below its initial value.
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the maxNodeDelegatorCount is never less than before the call.
After each call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the maxNodeDelegatorCount equals its previous value unchanged by that call.
After any call to updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount, maxNodeDelegatorCount equals the argument passed.
After calling updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount, the maxNodeDelegatorCount equals the argument passed.
After adding any number of node delegators, the maxNodeDelegatorCount is never less than the nodeDelegatorQueue length.
After adding node delegators (even zero), the stored maxNodeDelegatorCount equals the original argument passed to updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount, regardless of the queue length.
After a call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the stored maxNodeDelegatorCount equals the sum of the number of node delegators added plus the previously stored value.
After addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue is called with a non-empty array, the value of maxNodeDelegatorCount is always greater than or equal to the number of node delegators added.
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue with k elements, the stored maxNodeDelegatorCount is never decreased, i.e., is > previous value, if no prior updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount call was made.
After initialization, the maximum node delegator count should be exactly 10.
After initialization, the maxNodeDelegatorCount state variable should be 10.
After initialization, the maxNodeDelegatorCount should be exactly 10.
After initialization, the maximum number of node delegators that can be added is at least 10.
After initialization, maxNodeDelegatorCount should equal 10.
The total asset deposits is the sum of the three components from getAssetDistributionData.
asset lying in deposit pool plus asset lying in NDCs is always non-decreasing when called after addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue with a new non-zero address.
Adding a node delegator contract with a non-zero address increases or keeps the same total asset deposits when considering asset balance of the newly added delegator.
The total asset deposits is always at least the sum of the asset lying in deposit pool plus the asset staked in EigenLayer, ignoring assetLyingInNDCs.
Total asset deposits is greater than or equal to the asset lying in deposit pool plus asset staked in EigenLayer.
Total asset deposits is never less than asset lying in deposit pool plus asset lying in NDCs.
Total asset deposits is never less than the sum of asset lying in deposit pool and asset lying in NDCs.
getTotalAssetDeposits returns at least as much as the sum of asset lying in deposit pool and asset lying in NDCs.
getTotalAssetDeposits returns at least as much as assetLyingInDepositPool plus assetLyingInNDCs.
getTotalAssetDeposits returns a value that is at least as large as the sum of assetLyingInDepositPool and assetLyingInNDCs when assetStakedInEigenLayer is zero.
getTotalAssetDeposits returns a value that is at least as large as each of its three components individually.
The sum of assetLyingInDepositPool, assetLyingInNDCs, and assetStakedInEigenLayer (as returned by getAssetDistributionData) is equal to getTotalAssetDeposits.
For any address asset, getTotalAssetDeposits(asset) is greater than or equal to the sum of assetLyingInNDCs and assetStakedInEigenLayer from getAssetDistributionData(asset).
getTotalAssetDeposits(asset) is greater than or equal to each of assetLyingInDepositPool, assetLyingInNDCs, assetStakedInEigenLayer individually
getTotalAssetDeposits(asset) is greater than or equal to assetLyingInDepositPool (the balance of the contract itself).
For a supported asset, getTotalAssetDeposits must be greater than or equal to the deposit pool's balance of that asset.
getTotalAssetDeposits returns a value that is at least as large as the balance of the asset held directly by the deposit pool when there are valid node delegators.
getTotalAssetDeposits returns a value that is at least the sum of the individual component balances for a supported asset when there are node delegators with zero EigenLayer stakes.

For a supported asset, the sum of assetLyingInDepositPool, assetLyingInNDCs, and assetStakedInEigenLayer must be equal to getTotalAssetDeposits(asset) when both are computed via public view functions.
getTotalAssetDeposits of a supported asset must equal the sum of assetLyingInDepositPool, assetLyingInNDCs, and assetStakedInEigenLayer when all are publicly queried via getAssetDistributionData
getAssetCurrentLimit returns a value that is never greater than the deposit limit set in lrtConfig.
getAssetCurrentLimit always returns a value less than or equal to the deposit limit set in lrtConfig
Adding a node delegator contract does not increase the total asset deposits for any asset.
Adding a node delegator contract does not increase the deposit limit for any asset.
getAssetCurrentLimit returns a value that equals the deposit limit minus the sum of asset balances in the deposit pool and all node delegators.
